title: One-host build budget safeguards
summary: Added host-side coordination for heavy builds and browser tests, with bounded Cargo parallelism and safer cleanup of tracked test processes.
details: A cooperative lease admits one heavy task on the host; Cargo defaults to two jobs, work already in progress can finish, and failures trigger a cooldown even when the commit changes.

Release-state persistence is atomic and fail-closed. Browser-test cleanup tracks descendant processes. The one-shot launchd handoff waits for the previous watcher to exit, preserving the active release pass.
Stopped seven orphaned test-stack processes after confirming they had no active endpoint clients; active release and live services were preserved.

Host-only verification passed 17 focused host guard, release, and interpreter-routing tests; 23 desktop release tests; 12 Android build tests; and 2 owned-process Node tests (54 total), plus Python compilation and Node syntax checks. A host admission probe deferred correctly under elevated memory pressure.

The launchd storage preflight and background Git read both passed using the actual Python framework executable after Xcode received macOS external-volume access. No build started and no active service was restarted.
limitation: This is host tooling only, with no game logic changes or gameplay performance claim. Background release activation remains staged until the current release pass exits.
